# BuidlGuidl

> BuidlGuidl is a long-term technical partner to the Ethereum Foundation and teams across the ecosystem. We scope, build, and maintain production dapps, open-source tooling, and education programs, including Scaffold-ETH 2 (the Ethereum dapp starter kit) and Speedrun Ethereum (learn to build on Ethereum through hands-on challenges).

## Tools & products
- [Scaffold-ETH 2](https://scaffoldeth.io): open source toolkit for building Ethereum dapps with NextJS, Wagmi, Viem, and RainbowKit
- [Speedrun Ethereum](https://speedrunethereum.com): learn to build on Ethereum through hands-on Solidity challenges
- [ENS Builder Grants](https://builder.ensgrants.xyz/): the grants platform ENS runs to fund public goods in the Ethereum and Web3 ecosystems
- [BuidlGuidl Client](https://client.buidlguidl.com): one line command to run an Ethereum full node
- [abi.ninja](https://abi.ninja/): interact with any contract on Ethereum with a friendly UI/UX
- [Ethereum Job Board](https://www.ethereumjobboard.com/): find the best jobs in Ethereum, and post your own openings
- [Ethereum on Tour](https://tour.buidlguidl.com): bringing Ethereum curriculum, tools, and mentorship to you
- [Hacked Wallet Recovery](https://hackedwalletrecovery.com/): recover assets from a compromised wallet using Flashbots
- [Capture The Flag](https://ctf.buidlguidl.com/): reclaim the flags from the BuidlGuidl fortress by solving Ethereum coding challenges

## Site
- [Home](https://buidlguidl.com/): products, tools, and education for the Ethereum ecosystem
- [Projects](https://buidlguidl.com/projects): open source tools and apps we build and maintain
- [Blog](https://buidlguidl.com/blog): writing on tooling, education, and research
- [Batches](https://buidlguidl.com/batches): a program to level up as an open source dApp developer
- [2025 Recap](https://buidlguidl.com/2025): what BuidlGuidl shipped in 2025
- [Grants Archive](https://buidlguidl.com/grants): every grant, cohort, and builder stream BuidlGuidl funded, with the builders' own work logs

## Cohorts
Each cohort was a shared contract streaming ETH to a group of builders. Builders wrote down what they worked on when withdrawing; those logs are on each cohort page.
- [0xAfro](https://buidlguidl.com/grants/cohorts/0xafro): 3 builders, 12 ETH streamed
- [Autonomous Worlds (Jessy)](https://buidlguidl.com/grants/cohorts/autonomous-worlds): 7 builders, 7 ETH streamed
